competency.title: Design latency budgets — compute budget
competency.outcome: Design a deployable workflow for latency budgets using an end-to-end latency allocation. Fix a time, memory and energy budget before the run.

topic_kernel.failure_to_detect: hiding queue time outside the measurement

competency.practice_task: Produce a design, interfaces, failure paths and resource budget grounded in an end-to-end latency allocation.
competency.setting_constraint: Fix a time, memory and energy budget before the run.
required_evidence: a design, interfaces, failure paths and resource budget
Include resource log and quality per unit of compute.
Report p95 response time by stage with uncertainty or an explicit deterministic check.
Construct a negative control for the failure mode: hiding queue time outside the measurement.

assessment.scoring: Each criterion: 0 absent, 1 partial, 2 demonstrated; require 2 on all four.
assessment.threshold_policy: Register the metric threshold, baseline, task budget and evaluator before exposing new items.
criteria: Concept: correctly state the assumptions and limits of latency budgets.
Practice: an independent reviewer can execute its acceptance tests.
Measurement: report p95 response time by stage against a matched baseline with reproducible inputs.
Critical check: test for hiding queue time outside the measurement; detect it or rule it out with evidence.

competency.source_policy: Reviewer must add a verified primary source before lesson status; no source is fabricated here.
competency.contamination_policy: No private items, answers, seeds or reviewer-only prompts in this public specification.
